calibration_issued.description: issued calibration acceptance, ledger pins, battery-float verdicts

estimator_code.description: digest of measurement-core source; an acceptance or floor was issued against it

fixture_content.description: content address inside committed fixture data; stale only if the fixture bytes change

floor_artifact.description: issued floor-mint extraction specs and floor artifacts

historical_pin.description: test-held digest of a registration, acceptance, ledger or capture that is no longer in the tree

issued_code.description: digest of a deliberately frozen issued module (v1 analysis manifest, battery-float grammar, floor-mint pinsets); re-freeze from the reviewed base, never from a head

issued_config.description: other committed config pins (policies, panels, suites, readiness pins)

pack_config_bytes.description: pack config bytes, plan trees, order manifests and pack registrations

pinned_config_copy.description: a test's copy of a committed config, registration or pack file digest

recorded_evidence.description: digest of measured raw data or archived evidence bytes

source_digest.description: digest of source outside the measurement core; should be computed at test time

supply_map_production.description: production paper-supply roles; a validator change must re-issue paper values

synthetic_literal.description: digest of inline synthetic data or a test constant; no code edit can make it stale

followups.note: registration digests table keyed by literal; owned by L2 (plan §5 L7)

kinds.B: busywork: cannot go stale from a code edit, or is computed at test time
kinds.P: protects a number: kept hard-coded, checked by scripts/repin.py --check, never auto-repinned
